# hpe_morpheus_vdi_gateway (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus VDI Gateway resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_vdi_gateway" "example" {
  name        = "Example VDI Gateway"
  gateway_url = "https://vdi-gateway.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_url` (String) The URL of the VDI gateway.
- `name` (String) The name of the VDI gateway.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the VDI gateway.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the VDI gateway.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_vdi_gateway.example 123
```
